MIT RES.16-9960 The Engineering Student’s Guide to Effective Technical Communication, Spring 2026
Instructor: MIT AeroAstro Communication Lab
View the complete course: https:// ocw.mit.edu/courses/res-16-9960-the-engineering-students-guide-to-effective-technical-communication-spring-2026/
The thesis proposal is a key milestone in most doctoral programs. This lesson walks you through planning, writing, and defending a proposal, and helps you start thinking about your own, no matter where you are in the research process.
